sentences.en: Accounting knowledge is necessary for the success of any company.
sentences.zh: 任何公司的成功都需要会计知识。

sentences.en: Do you do double-entry accounting or traditional governmental accounting?
sentences.zh: 你是做复式记账还是传统的政府会计？

sentences.en: The first principle of accounting is the principle of going concern.
sentences.zh: 会计的第一原则是持续经营原则。
